videos.title: Field Engineer Habits: Daily Practices That Prevent Rework
videos.keyTakeaway: FEs who wear their bags, double-check differently, keep field books, and communicate constantly prevent rework.
videos.whyMatters: These habits are foundational — experienced FEs practice them daily, and they're the fastest way to look competent on day one.

videos.title: Four Mental Frameworks Experienced PMs Use on Site
videos.keyTakeaway: Right to Build, Constructability Review, Zone Control, and Punch-as-You-Go are four decision frameworks that prevent rework and schedule slippage before they happen.
videos.whyMatters: Field Engineers who think in these frameworks catch problems earlier than ones who just react to what's in front of them.
